cityImages.title: City images
cityImages.subtitle: The image the VIP app shows behind the greeting: the departure city first, then the destination. A city without an image shows the brand background with its name. Uploading or replacing takes effect within minutes, with no deploy.
cityImages.search: Search by code, city or airport

fields.name: City name
fields.airportsHint: Codes separated by commas. CDG and ORY use the Paris image.
fields.imageHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 8 MB. Landscape, 4:3, with the important part in the centre; ideally 1600 × 1200 px. It is cropped and converted to WebP automatically.
fields.removeImage: Remove the image (the brand background is shown)
